_meta.title: ILO Domestic Workers Convention, 2011 (No. 189): ratifications
_meta.what: Countries that have ratified the ILO convention giving domestic workers (cleaners, nannies, carers in private homes) the same basic labour rights as other workers. Countries not in the file have not ratified. value = "ratified". 40 countries, matching the ILO's own total of 40 (June 2026).
_meta.source: United Nations Treaty Series, registration no. 51379, Convention (No. 189) concerning Decent Work for Domestic Workers (ratifications registered by the International Labour Organisation); plus ILO news for Spain
